en: Title: *Nīlakaṇṭhadhāraṇī* (also known as *Source*) Source: La Vallée Poussin, Louis and Robert Gauthiot. “XIX. Fragment final de la Nilakanthadharani en brahmi et en transcription sogdienne. *Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society* 44/3 (1912): 629–645 (plus 1 plate). [Minor Stotras] Tibetan: D 697/905

[Fragment begins] O Siddhayogīśvara, *dhuru* 2, you who possess great vigor (*vīryaṃ te mahāvīryaṃ te*), O Lord of the Dharaṇī-dragons, move, move! O you of stainless and pure form, O Noble Avalokiteśvara with black matted hair, with a crown hanging down or dangling long, O Great Siddha-Vidyādhara, *bala* 2, O Great Power, *mala* 2, O Great Purity, move, move, O Great Mover! O Black-Colored One, O Destroyer of the Dark Fortnight, come, come, O Lotus-Handed One, move, move, O Lord of Night-Walkers, O you whose sacred thread is made of a black serpent! Come, come, O Great Boar-Faced One, O Lord of the Great Burner of the Three Cities, O You who possess the form, strength, and speed of Nārāyaṇa, O Blue-Throated One, O You who have conquered the Great Hālāhala poison, O Destroyer of the world’s poison of passion, destroyer of the poison of hatred, destroyer of the poison of delusion! *Hulu* 2, *mālā huru*, remove, remove! O Great Padmanābha, run, run, *siri* 2, *suru* 2, awaken, awaken, cause to awaken! I awaken you, O Blue-Throated One; come, come, O Lion-Faced One residing on the left! Laugh, laugh, let out a great, loud roar! Come, come, O Great Siddha-Yogīśvara! Speak, speak! Accomplish the word! Remember the Vidyā! Grant me a vision of the Blessed One, Lokitavilokita, the Tathāgata; grant me a vision of Kāma! Gladden my mind, svāhā! Svāhā to the Siddha! Svāhā to the Mahāsiddha! Svāhā to the Siddhayogīśvara! Svāhā to the Blue-Throated One! Svāhā to the Boar-Faced One! Svāhā to the Great Lion-Faced One! Svāhā to the Siddha-Vidyādhara! Svāhā to the Lotus-Handed One! Svāhā to the one whose sacred thread is a great black serpent! Svāhā to the Great Club-Bearer! Svāhā to the one whose weapon is the discus! Svāhā to the one awakened by the sound of the conch! Svāhā to the one wearing a black antelope skin upon his left shoulder! Svāhā to the one clothed in tiger skin! Svāhā to Lokiteśvara! Svāhā to the Lord of All Siddhas! Homage to the Blessed Noble Avalokiteśvara, the Bodhisattva, the Mahāsattva, the Great Compassionate One! May these mantra-words be effective, svāhā!
The Dhāraṇī of the Name Nīlakaṇṭha is completed. || O ||
